items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: I was playing with Rene Punch by the Petit.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Uh Cy Frazier uh 16 to the second 61. Uh anybody in your family start playing drums Cy you know. Yeah my oldest brother Sam Frazier. Sam Frazier. Yeah. Well who did he play with anybody?
I was playing with Rene Punch by the Petit. It was way around 1917, 16, 18. All beginning of World War I.
Well uh when was your birthday? When were you born? Uh February 23rd, 1904. February 23rd? 1904. Same as me, February 23rd.
